review_candidates.title: Cloud Infrastructure Specialist
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Qualifications Strong cloud infrastructure and on-premises Infrastructure skills, including design, deployment, and maintenance of scalable environments. Solid Troubleshooting capabilities for infrastructure, networking, and performance issues across multi-cloud or hybrid environments. Relevant certifications in cloud, networking, or security (e.g., AWS Certified SysOps, Azure Administrator, CCNA, Security+) are a plus.
eligibility_evidence: Solid Troubleshooting capabilities for infrastructure, networking, and performance issues across multi-cloud or hybrid environments.

review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications Strong cloud infrastructure and on-premises Infrastructure skills, including design, deployment, and maintenance of scalable environments. Proficiency with automation and scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python) to streamline deployments and operational tasks.
